test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: With which of the following countries is ‘Khon’, the masked drama dance performance depicting the glory of Lord Rama, associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thailand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khon is a performance art **that includes aspects of music, voice, literature, dance, ritual, and craftsmanship. It is known as the** Khon Masked Dance** Drama in Thailand.
 
• Performing Khon dates back to the **Ayutthaya Kingdom.**
 
• Men in masks perform it only at the royal court, together with narrators and a traditional piphat ensemble.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The life and greatness of Rama, the hero an**d god Vishnu's incarnation who establishes order and justice in the universe** are portrayed in Khon performances, which have a strong didactic purpose.
 
• It combines** singing, speech, dancing, beautiful costumes, and music.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
